subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Nürburgring Nordschleife
description: A fast breakdown of The Nürburgring Nordschleife for builders.

hook.text: The Nürburgring Nordschleife is a 13-mile circuit through German forests with 154 corners.

buildup.text: Blind crests, elevation changes of 300 meters, and no runoff make it the most dangerous track alive.

discovery.text: Automakers use Nordschleife lap times as the ultimate benchmark to prove a car's performance.

twist.text: Jackie Stewart nicknamed it 'The Green Hell'—and that was before modern cars doubled the speeds.

climax.text: A Porsche 919 Evo set a lap record of 5:19 in 2018—an average of over 145 mph through the forest.

punchline.text: The scariest racetrack on Earth is also the industry's proving ground.

quiz.question: How many corners does the Nürburgring Nordschleife have?

details.summary: The Nurburgring Nordschleife is a 12.9-mile racing circuit through Germany's Eifel mountains with 154 turns, elevation changes over 1,000 feet, and a fearsome reputation as the ultimate automotive proving ground.
details.whyItMatters: Automakers use Nordschleife lap times as the definitive measure of a car's performance. A fast Nurburgring lap has become the most credible benchmark for sports car and supercar capability.
takeaways: The 12.9-mile Nordschleife has 154 corners and is nicknamed the Green Hell
Jackie Stewart gave it the Green Hell name after racing there in fog
Manufacturers chase sub-seven-minute lap times as performance proof

faq.question: Can anyone drive on the Nurburgring?
faq.answer: Yes. The Nordschleife is open to the public as a toll road during tourist driving sessions. Anyone with a road-legal car can pay a fee and lap the circuit, though some famously crash in the process.

faq.question: What is the fastest car around the Nordschleife?
faq.answer: Records change frequently, but the Porsche 911 GT2 RS MR and Mercedes-AMG One have both posted sub-six-minute-thirty-second times. The arms race for the fastest Nurburgring time among manufacturers is intense.
